I am not a doctor, but my guess is that the increased mental clarity you are experiencing may have something to do with the increased blood flow produced by your workouts. During strenuous exercise, your heart starts pumping hard and fast, right? There might be some other factors, like maybe an increase in the production of specific neurological chemicals. I don't know.

If this is true, then I suggest you try replacing some of your workout routine with cardiovascular exercises like bicycling instead of weight training. With cycling in particular, there is far less of a chance of getting a serious injury. Cycling is a very low impact exercise, but it allows you to really get your circulatory system in good shape. If I had to guess, I would say that high intensity interval training might be able to produce the same effect for you. Of course, I would not recommend that you jump straight into strenuous cardio if you have any heart or lung conditions.
